meta.title: Budget Consumption Tracking: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Access or inspect the Budget Consumption Tracking capability.
Verify the same Finance Controller workflow is refused or absent on a Growth-plan tenant and available on an Enterprise-plan tenant.
Switch or identify tenants by Growth versus Enterprise plan while preserving the same user role.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Access or inspect the Budget Consumption Tracking capability.; Verify the same Finance Controller workflow is refused or absent on a Growth-plan tenant and available on an Enterprise-plan tenant.; Switch or identify tenants by Growth versus Enterprise plan while preserving the same user role.

args.need: sign in as a Finance Controller, inspect Budget Consumption Tracking on the Growth-plan tenant and the Enterprise-plan tenant, and report whether the capability is absent or refused on Growth and usable on Enterprise

steps.note: The catalog cannot reach or observe Budget Consumption Tracking or compare tenant plans.
Confirm the tester's resulting screen is free of crashes or server errors, without claiming that the budget capability itself was verified.
